description.zh: Victor42 自研的 AI Agent 能力包。每个 skill 是一组结构化指令，安装后你的 Agent 在特定场景下会自动调用。用 skills CLI 一键安装，或打开详情页复制命令。
description.en: Capability packs for AI agents by Victor42. Each skill is a structured instruction set your agent loads for specific tasks. Install with the skills CLI, or copy the command from a detail page.

summary.zh: 多轮任务跨 Agent 工具切换时的上下文交接包。只保留下一棒 Agent 继续推进所需的最小信息，可落在本机目录，也可走你自己的对象存储。
summary.en: Minimal context packages for switching AI tools mid-task. Keeps only what the next agent needs — on disk or in your own object bucket.

zh.heading: 它做什么
items: 换到另一个 AI 工具时，生成一份临时交接包
核心只回答一个问题：下一棒 Agent 要继续推进，还缺什么？
默认只写 notes.md；脚本、结构化数据、长日志才单独成文件

zh.heading: 两种交接通道
items: 本地目录（默认）：写成本机 handoff-<主题>/，不依赖网络和凭据
对象存储（可选）：放进你自己的 bucket，跨机器、跨工具都能取
先探活再选：云端不通会问你要本地方案还是修云端，不静默降级

zh.heading: 交接包里有什么
items: Goal / Context / Current State（已完成 · 已验证 · 待办）/ Handoff Notes
只保留继续推进所必需的路径、决策与约束
接手方做完全部待办后删除整个包；够不到位置时由你删除

zh.heading: 何时触发
items: 你明确说「交接」「handoff」「换 Agent」「我要换工具继续」
多轮任务中途要换工具，又不想丢上下文

en.heading: What it does
items: Builds a temporary handoff package when you switch AI tools mid-task
Answers one question: what does the next agent need to keep going?
Defaults to notes.md only; scripts, structured data, and long logs get separate files

en.heading: Two channels
items: Local directory (default): a handoff-<theme>/ folder on disk, no network or credentials
Object storage (opt-in): your own bucket, readable across machines and tools
Probe first: if the cloud path is down it asks whether to go local or fix it — no silent downgrade

en.heading: What's in the package
items: Goal / Context / Current State (done · verified · open) / Handoff Notes
Only the paths, decisions and constraints needed to continue
The receiving agent deletes the whole package when every task is done; it asks you if it can't reach it

en.heading: When it triggers
items: You explicitly ask for a handoff / agent switch / tool transfer
A multi-turn task needs to survive switching AI tools

summary.zh: CLI 工具集：图片格式转换、缩放、去重、GIF 合成、音视频转换、公众号文章视频下载、文件夹扁平化等批量文件操作。
summary.en: CLI toolkit for format conversion, resize, dedup, GIF compose, audio/video convert, WeChat article video download, and bulk file operations.

zh.heading: 图片
items: 格式互转：jpg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff
Resize：指定宽高，裁剪或填充
缩放：设定最大边长，保持比例
裁头像：自动检测人脸，输出圆形或方形
去重：感知哈希识别相似图
GIF：多帧合成 / GIF 拆成帧序列

zh.heading: 音视频
items: 音频互转：mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
视频互转：mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm 等
从视频提取音轨
多张图片合成视频，支持交叉淡入淡出

zh.heading: 下载
items: 下载微信公众号文章内嵌视频，按视频标题命名，可选最高清或全部清晰度

zh.heading: 文件管理
items: 嵌套文件夹一键扁平化
按 CSV 批量重命名
支持单文件与整文件夹批量处理

en.heading: Images
items: Convert among jpg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff
Resize with crop or pad modes
Scale by max edge while keeping aspect ratio
Avatar crop with face detection (circle or square)
Dedup via perceptual hash
Compose GIF from frames / explode GIF to frames

en.heading: Audio & video
items: Convert audio: mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
Convert video: mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm, and more
Extract audio tracks from video
Images → video with optional crossfade

en.heading: Download
items: Download videos embedded in WeChat articles, named by video title, best-quality or all resolutions

en.heading: Files
items: Flatten nested folders in one pass
Batch rename from CSV
Works on single files or whole folders

summary.zh: 四个国内旅行数据源的调用契约：高德、飞常准、携程火车、Open-Meteo。含编码规则、错误分层与实测坑，另附旅行的两种模式与规划顺序。只给数据与顺序，不排行程。
summary.en: Call contracts for four China travel data sources — Amap, Variflight, Ctrip trains, Open-Meteo — with code formats, error layers and verified pitfalls, plus two travel modes and the planning order. Data and order only, no itinerary.

zh.heading: 四个数据源
items: 高德 Web 服务：地址↔坐标、POI 检索、驾车/步行/公交路线、天气、地图瓦片
飞常准：计划航班、中转方案、机票价格，需 Key
携程 SSR：车次、历时、余票、票价，无需 Key
Open-Meteo：天气预报、城市地理编码、历史天气，无需 Key

zh.heading: 写进文档的坑
items: 地理编码只到城市/门牌级，景点坐标必须走 POI 检索
飞常准：航班用机场三字码，中转与价格用城市三字码
航班列表不按时刻排序，问「最早/末班」要自己排
401 报错会让你去加一个服务端根本不读的请求头

zh.heading: 规划地基
items: 游览与度假两套公式，决定整份计划的重心
两条规划顺序：先锁不可逆的交通与天数，再定可改的景点与餐厅
只到模式与顺序，不给景点筛选与小时级日程

zh.heading: 边界
items: 不抓大众点评 / 小红书：无公开 API，风控严格
不共享 Key、不绕过验证码
数据可以给全，结论由人下

en.heading: Four sources
items: Amap: geocoding, POI search, driving/walking/transit routes, weather, map tiles
Variflight: schedules, transfers, fares — needs a key
Ctrip SSR: trains, duration, availability, fares — no key
Open-Meteo: forecast, city geocoding, historical weather — no key

en.heading: Pitfalls written down
items: Geocoding stops at city/door level; POI coordinates need place/text
Variflight: airport codes for flights, city codes for transfers and fares
Flight lists are not time-sorted — sort before answering first/last
The 401 message points at a header the API never reads

en.heading: Planning basis
items: Two formulas — sightseeing vs vacation — that set the whole plan's centre of gravity
Two planning orders: lock irreversible transport and days first, then moveable attractions and meals
Modes and order only; no attraction shortlisting, no hour-level schedule

en.heading: Boundaries
items: No scraping Dianping / Xiaohongshu: no public API, strict anti-bot
No key sharing, no captcha bypass
Data can be complete; the conclusion stays with the human

summary.zh: 古典诗词深度解读方法：从时代、作者、地理、文学性、传统、接受史六个维度立体读一首诗。
summary.en: In-depth classical Chinese poetry interpretation from six lenses: era, author, geography, craft, tradition, and reception history.

zh.heading: 六维读法
items: 【世】时代背景：这首诗何以在此刻写成
【人】作者生平：诗人的处境与意图
【地】地理：地名、空间与意象如何落地
【统】文学传统：它继承或改写了什么
【受】接受史：后人如何读它、为什么传下来
【文】作品本体：技艺与结构——它为何是艺术

zh.heading: 产出形态
items: 出版级深度解读，而非一行翻译或浅层赏析
先写六合草稿，再收敛创作前时间线，最后合成可读文本
服务对象：有好奇心、无专业文学素养的深度读者

zh.heading: 适用与否
items: 适用：古典诗歌历史名篇（作者、系年、接受史有据可查）
不适用：简单翻译、现代自由诗、作者不可考或信息极度稀薄的篇目

en.heading: Six lenses
items: Era: why this poem was written in this moment
Author: the poet's situation and intent
Geography: places, space, and how imagery lands
Tradition: what it inherits or rewrites
Reception: how later readers shaped its afterlife
Craft: structure and technique — why it is art

en.heading: What you get
items: Publication-grade interpretation, not a one-line gloss
Draft across six lenses → converge pre-composition timeline → readable synthesis
For curious deep readers without specialist literary training

en.heading: Fit
items: Best for well-documented classical poems
Not for simple translation, modern free verse, or barely attested texts

summary.zh: 用短促的苏格拉底对话推动思考，同时在侧边维护一份持续生长、无损展开的认知框架。
summary.en: Build a living cognitive model beside concise Socratic dialogue, expanding ideas in place without losing confirmed detail.

zh.heading: 双表面共建
items: 聊天保持短促、具体，每轮最多推进一个因果问题
Living Surface 承载完整模型，随对话原位展开而不是记录流水账
适配原生侧边文档、本地 Markdown 与云端远程文档三类环境

zh.heading: 认知方法
items: 先锁定使用者、目标、场景与现实约束，再构建框架
从微观现象切入，向下寻找第一性原理底座并标记跨层因果
保留可证伪假设、反例、具体案例与所有已确认细节

zh.heading: 适用与边界
items: 适用：明确要求认知塑形或多轮共建持续生长的认知模型
不适用：普通解释、一次性分析、翻译或内容发布
云端默认使用 secret Gist；它仅未公开列出，并非私密存储，失败时回退为聊天全文

en.heading: Two coordinated surfaces
items: Keeps chat concise and concrete, advancing at most one causal question per turn
Maintains the full model in a Living Surface that expands in place instead of becoming a transcript
Adapts to native side documents, local Markdown, and remote cloud documents

en.heading: Cognitive method
items: Locks the user, goal, scene, and real constraints before building the framework
Enters through a micro-phenomenon, then finds first-principles bedrock and cross-layer causality
Preserves falsifiable hypotheses, counterexamples, concrete cases, and every confirmed detail

en.heading: Fit and boundaries
items: Use for explicit Cognition Shaper requests or multi-turn co-building of a living cognitive model
Not for ordinary explanations, one-shot analysis, translation, or publishing
Cloud mode defaults to a secret Gist; it is unlisted, not private, with full-document chat fallback
